BUG-PATTERN 2026-11-11 (shard-measurement wave 20261111-0252/0310, blueprint d90461a51f51; debug-1 report .tmp/progress/20261111-0252-shard-measurement.debug-1.md): reviewer-rejected S04/S05/S07 share ONE root cause — the harness oracle observed the code's own self-reports instead of persisted state or the wrong implementation's distinguishing input. Measured survivors (scratch copies shard-review-mutant-2/-3, isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR, offline locked): (1) deleting the auxiliary remap persistence block (lib.rs:736-750 DELETE+INSERT) left test_cross_db_mapping_preserves_payload_and_rejects_unknowns GREEN because the test only asserts JSON flags (payload_preserved/collision_refused) the code under test writes itself (lib.rs:751/767) and never reopens episodic.db/prompts.db/skills.db/metadata.db — 4 files cover all 8 table manifests; fix = reopen closed DBs after handle drop, typed-compare every row against mapped_rows (blobs as bytes, NULL as NULL). (2) deleting `|| root.exists()` (lib.rs:41) left test_refuses_outside_or_symlink_root GREEN because the only existing-root input was nonempty reuse, whose refusal create_dir(AlreadyExists) reproduces identically at is_err level; fix = pre-create an EMPTY dir under runs/ and assert_eq the error payload against root.display() (guard emits the path; mutant emits "Os { code: 17, kind: AlreadyExists ... }") — is_err-only is measured-vacuous. (3) S04: run_case always returned the zero Observation (lib.rs:65-75) while raw_copy measured everything into raw-copy.json and returned MResult<()> — fix = raw_copy returns its result Json, run_case populates schema/duration_ms/artifact_paths from it, test cross-checks Observation vs artifact, duration_ms > 0. (4) S05: Case enum had only Containment/RawCopy; inspect() exercised directly, so no per-case persisted observation artifact and no populated duplicate_occurrences; fix = add ExactDuplicates/DivergentIds/CrossDb variants routed through run_case with persisted per-case JSON asserted from TWO surfaces (Observation + artifact). Same vacuous-oracle family as mem_1793066631237 (2026-10-27 six instances) and mem_1792550463914 (W5.3): fixture written from the correct implementation's outputs, missing the wrong implementation's distinguishing input.
